shell_commands: /usr/bin/zsh -lc "pwd && sed -n '1,240p' ../ticket.md && if [ -f ../round-brief.md ]; then sed -n '1,260p' ../round-brief.md; fi && sed -n '1,260p' .lore/dod.md"

/usr/bin/zsh -lc "git status --short && sed -n '1,220p' src/orchestration/tools/registry.ts && sed -n '1,240p' src/orchestration/tools/registry.test.ts && sed -n '70,140p' src/orchestration/tools/registry.acceptance.test.ts && sed -n '1,240p' specs/hal-engine-tool-input-validation/spec.md && sed -n '1,200p' .lore/test-commands.yml && cat package.json"

/usr/bin/zsh -lc "sed -n '1,125p' src/orchestration/tools/registry.acceptance.test.ts && rg \"interface ErrorObject|type ErrorObject\" node_modules/ajv node_modules/@types -g '*.d.ts' | head -20 && node --input-type=module -e \"import Ajv from 'ajv'; const a=new Ajv({strict:false,validateFormats:false}); const v=a.compile({type:'object',properties:{ssn:{type:'string'}},required:['ssn']}); v({ssn:123456789}); console.log(v.errors)\""

/usr/bin/zsh -lc 'if [ -f scripts/spec-links/reanchor.mjs ]; then echo present; else echo absent; fi && npx prettier --write src/orchestration/tools/registry.ts src/orchestration/tools/registry.test.ts specs/hal-engine-tool-input-validation/spec.md'
/usr/bin/zsh -lc "nl -ba src/orchestration/tools/registry.test.ts | sed -n '1,110p' && git diff --check && git diff -- . ':"'!package-lock.json'"'"

/usr/bin/zsh -lc "rg -n \"it\\('(rejects input missing|rejects a wrong|throws at register|returns a schema rejection)\" src/orchestration/tools/registry.acceptance.test.ts src/orchestration/tools/registry.test.ts"

/usr/bin/zsh -lc 'npx prettier --write src/orchestration/tools/registry.ts src/orchestration/tools/registry.test.ts specs/hal-engine-tool-input-validation/spec.md .lore/dod.md && timeout 300 npm test -- --runTestsByPath src/orchestration/tools/registry.test.ts --runInBand'

/usr/bin/zsh -lc 'git diff --check && git status --short && git diff --stat && git diff -- .lore/dod.md src/orchestration/tools/registry.ts src/orchestration/tools/registry.test.ts specs/hal-engine-tool-input-validation/spec.md'

/usr/bin/zsh -lc 'git add .lore/dod.md specs/hal-engine-tool-input-validation/spec.md src/orchestration/tools/registry.test.ts src/orchestration/tools/registry.ts && git commit -m "Log tool input validation failures" && git push origin HEAD'
/usr/bin/zsh -lc 'git fetch origin main && git merge --no-edit origin/main && git push origin HEAD && git status --short --branch'
